description: This file defines the IPackageManager interface and related classes for package management operations such as install, uninstall, download, reset, metadata handling, locking, and notifications within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: IPackageManager
classes.description: Interface for managing application packages, including installation, uninstallation, download, reset, metadata, locking, and notifications.

classes.name: IPackageManagerBroker
classes.description: Interface for offering and revoking package manager instances.

classes.name: IPackageManagerCallback
classes.description: Interface for receiving asynchronous operation status updates.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Downloads and installs an application bundle.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a resource file for an application.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Deletes all persistent local data of the application.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details about app and persistent storage usage.

methods.name: SetAuxMetadata
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair of metadata for the application.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata and auxiliary resource list for an application.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a previously issued asynchronous request.

methods.name: GetProgress
methods.description: Provides the current progress of an ongoing operation.

methods.name: GetList
methods.description: Retrieves list of installed apps matching given filters.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks an application to prevent uninstallation.

methods.name: GetLockInfo
methods.description: Provides lock reason and owner for an app.

methods.name: Offer
methods.description: Offers a package manager instance to the broker.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a package manager instance from the broker.

methods.name: OperationStatusUpdate
methods.description: Receives updates on the status of package operations.
